context_owner_candidate_status: Not adopted: the user requires comparison with the original API framework; disabling SDK compaction changes that behavior.
scope: Current installed SDK 0.2.186 / bundled Claude Code 2.1.329; original handoff source is read-only; historical SDK version and historical model are not established.

probes.trigger: Synthetic 980000 input-token usage, otherwise normal Read round trip
One synthetic standard HTTP 400 prompt-too-long after Read; original compact settings

probes.interpretation: The switch works but changes behavior; capture completion is not a successful solving gate.

native_documentation_fact: Unset model_auto_compact_token_limit uses model defaults; no current effective numeric threshold was established by this audit.

comparison.original: SDK provides full current message history on each model call, including SDK changes and compacted history.
comparison.cli_bridge: Persistent native thread receives only new user input and tool replies; assistant/tool history revisions are not reapplied.

comparison.original: Default SDK behavior, with inherited optional environment override only.
comparison.cli_bridge: Independent native compaction plus SDK compaction; captured compacted requests create a second state or stop a teacher when the phase changes.

comparison.original: Proxy requests temperature/top_p/max_tokens, with request-level overrides.
comparison.cli_bridge: Thread/turn calls specify fixed model and low effort, not these three request values.

comparison.original: Claude SDK executes tools in task containers.
comparison.cli_bridge: Same SDK executor; corrected transport preserves tested calls/results, while native Terra requires code mode.
comparison.evidence: preflight/parallel_09_transport_audit/result.json; 9 tool results, 2 SDK phases, 0 true model calls

comparison.original: No ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false override in original create_agent_options.
comparison.cli_bridge: Static 18 tools are exposed by the added override; original lazy loading is not preserved.

comparison.original: Original SDK preset or explicit teacher system prompt is sent via API.
comparison.cli_bridge: System/developer messages are combined at thread start and an extra external-tool developer instruction is added. Later revisions are not reapplied.

comparison.original: Handoff requirements explicitly say not a historical lockfile and specify claude-agent-sdk>=0.1.60.
comparison.cli_bridge: Current tests use SDK0.2.186/CLI2.1.329 and Terra; historical model/version equality is unconfirmed.

conclusion: Tool execution compatibility was demonstrated for tested cases. Exact original API input, sampling, context-management, and model-harness equivalence is not established and the current persistent bridge demonstrably differs. No small verified compatibility patch removes all differences.
unadopted_alternative: Reconstruct native context from each SDK request and replay exact structured history. This remains unverified, especially no-extra-user-message turn start, code-mode cell lifecycle, and request-level sampling support; do not deploy or describe as equivalent.
